# Melange Digital

> Melange Digital is a travel and tourism marketing agency that turns cultural insight into measurable arrivals for national tourism boards, DMOs, travel tech brands, and travel companies — combining destination storytelling, influencer marketing, and SEO/AEO execution across India, GCC, and global markets.

Founded and led by Sanket Bolinjkar (15+ years in destination marketing, influencer strategy, and travel-sector SEO/AEO). Headquartered in Goa and Mumbai, India, with team presence in the UK, UAE, Singapore, and Zambia. Clients include national tourism boards (Singapore Tourism Board, Hong Kong Tourism Board, Saudi Tourism Authority, Zambia Tourism Authority) and travel brands (Resorts World Cruises, Costa Cruises). Note: melangedigital.co is mid-transition from a general digital marketing positioning to a travel-and-tourism-only positioning — a few pages on this domain still reflect the prior general-marketing scope and should not be treated as representative of current service focus.

## Company
- [Homepage](https://melangedigital.co/): Positioning, service summary, proof points, and case study highlights for tourism boards and travel brands.
- [About](https://melangedigital.co/about): Agency background and leadership.
- [Services](https://melangedigital.co/services): Full service list — brand strategy and planning, influencer marketing, immersive brand storytelling, SEO and AEO, familiarisation trips, content strategy and production, PR/IPs and outreach.
- [Contact](https://melangedigital.co/contact): Primary conversion page — book a strategy call.

## Case Studies
- [Resorts World Cruises](https://melangedigital.co/work/resorts-world-cruises): GCC market launch — $2.3M in attributed sales across three audiences and three languages, one integrated team.
- [Costa Cruises](https://melangedigital.co/work/costa-cruises): 9,000+ qualified enquiries generated from a single maiden-voyage campaign.
- [All case studies](https://melangedigital.co/work): Full portfolio archive, spanning travel/tourism and legacy non-travel work.

## Insights
- [Destination Marketing in Tourism](https://melangedigital.co/blogs/destination-marketing-in-tourism): What destination marketing means for DMOs and tourism boards, tied to arrivals and visitor spend rather than awareness.
- [Travel Influencer Marketing](https://melangedigital.co/blogs/travel-influencer-marketing): How tourism boards and travel brands should pick creators and measure ROI against bookings, not views.
- [Experiential Tourism Guide 2026](https://melangedigital.co/blogs/experiential-tourism-guide): How experiential travel is changing destination choice, and what DMOs need to do next.
- [All articles](https://melangedigital.co/blogs): Full article archive.

## Research
- [India Outbound Tourism Trends 2026](https://melangedigital.co/destination-marketing-agency): Survey of 4,200 Indian outbound-eligible travellers on what triggers a destination decision, with a downloadable report.
